lessons_used: Moving sign-in after pet adoption (+16.8% vs +12.0%) and adding cloud storage backup copy (+4.9% vs +0.5%) were helpful and exceeded predictions, while sign-in hints, progress trackers, safeguards, and other reorders showed no clear effect.

Dynamic waiting screen additions (live progress visualizer, audio-visual ambiance) were helpful, with visualizers far exceeding predictions (+9.3% vs +2.0%), while static estimates, checklists, audio selectors, and mascot updates showed no clear effect.

Photo quality sound tips were helpful and exceeded predictions (+8.7% vs +2.0%), whereas adoption certificate redesigns severely hurt performance (-27.5%) and card layout or sound preview changes showed no clear effect.
Desktop mascot audio welcome redesign on the finish screen was helpful (+7.5% vs -3.0%), but control guides, prompts, soundboard redesigns, and incentives showed no clear effect.
All welcome path selection changes (copy, layout, and direct selection cards) showed no clear effect, with predictions consistently overestimating impact.

lessons_next: Sign-in changes like moving sign-in after adoption (+16.8%), adding cloud storage copy (+4.9%), and card spotlight redesign (+6.3%) were helpful, often exceeding predictions, whereas other reorders, hints, and safeguards showed no clear effect.

Dynamic waiting screen additions (live progress visualizer, audio-visual ambiance) were helpful, with visualizers far exceeding predictions (+9.3% vs +2.0%), while static estimates, checklists, selectors, and activity stages showed no clear effect.

Photo quality sound tips were helpful and exceeded predictions (+8.7% vs +2.0%), whereas adoption certificate redesigns severely hurt performance (-27.5%) and card layout or sound preview changes showed no clear effect.

Desktop mascot audio welcome redesign on the finish screen was helpful and beat predictions (+7.5% vs -3.0%), but control guides, prompts, incentives, headline copy, and soundboard redesigns showed no clear effect.

Welcome path changes yielded no positive results: story split highlight redesign severely hurt performance (-10.8%), while all other copy, layout, and direct selection card changes showed no clear effect.
